verdict.rationale: PayPal documents refunds in the business dashboard ('issue refunds directly in the PayPal business dashboard'). It also documents API refunds through server-side endpoints for refunds and the create_refund/get_refund tools, so both channels in the story are covered. missing for 10: explicit evidence of partial-amount (vs. full) refund support in either channel, detailed refund API reference docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
